output.markdown:
## Yellow taxi trips dropped 45.5% on Thanksgiving 2024 vs baseline Thursdays

On Thursday 28 November 2024, NYC yellow taxi trips fell to 77,244, a 45.5% decline from the baseline average of 141,603 trips per Thursday. The drop is driven by Thanksgiving Day, a national holiday present only on the target date; the three prior Thursdays (7, 14, 21 November) had no national holiday and normal trip volumes.

**Recommendation:** Investigate post-holiday recovery patterns and non-holiday Thursday demand to gauge whether the drop is a one-time holiday effect or indicative of a longer-term shift; monitor fare mix changes separately as they do not drive trip volume.

### Evidence-backed claims
1. Trips on 2024-11-28 were 77,244, -45.5% vs an average of 141,603 over the comparable baseline days [Q2 · sha256:abebf19e2eec10e6 · whybot.yellow_daily]
2. Thanksgiving Day (2024-11-28) caused the drop in trips [Q3 · sha256:214a05580b382109 · whybot.yellow_daily]
3. The shift in fare mix on 2024-11-28 does not explain the drop in trips [Q1 · sha256:dda3947caccf42ad · whybot.yellow_daily]

### Caveats
- Data quality (not evidence): the TPCDS date_dim.d_holiday flag disagrees with Nager.Date on 3 date(s): 2024-10-14: d_holiday=N, Nager.Date: Columbus Day (national holiday); 2024-11-11: d_holiday=N, Nager.Date: Veterans Day (national holiday); 2024-11-28: d_holiday=N, Nager.Date: Thanksgiving Day (national holiday). Holidays come from Nager.Date only [DQ1 sha256:ff7eddb0f4eb3255].

_Confidence 0.95. Data source: LIVE Zetaris Lightning (JDBC)._

evidence.purpose: Baseline summary for trips: return ONE row with target_date (the target 2024-11-28), target_value (the trips on the target), baseline_avg (the average daily trips over the comparable baseline days: 2024-11-07,2024-11-14,2024-11-21; never include the target), baseline_days (how many baseline days), and pct_change_vs_baseline = (target_value - baseline_avg) / baseline_avg * 100. Read the table once with conditional aggregation (MAX(CASE WHEN <date> = <target> THEN ... END), AVG(CASE WHEN <date> IN (<baseline days>) THEN ... END)) over WHERE <date> IN (target and baseline days), the target date as a literal (DATE '<target>' AS target_date); no GROUP BY, no join and no subquery.
evidence.sql: SELECT DATE '2024-11-28' AS target_date, MAX(CASE WHEN trip_date = DATE '2024-11-28' THEN trips END) AS target_value, AVG(CASE WHEN trip_date IN (DATE '2024-11-07', DATE '2024-11-14', DATE '2024-11-21') THEN trips END) AS baseline_avg, COUNT(CASE WHEN trip_date IN (DATE '2024-11-07', DATE '2024-11-14', DATE '2024-11-21') THEN 1 END) AS baseline_days, (MAX(CASE WHEN trip_date = DATE '2024-11-28' THEN trips END) - AVG(CASE WHEN trip_date IN (DATE '2024-11-07', DATE '2024-11-14', DATE '2024-11-21') THEN trips END)) / AVG(CASE WHEN trip_date IN (DATE '2024-11-07', DATE '2024-11-14', DATE '2024-11-21') THEN trips END) * 100 AS pct_change_vs_baseline FROM whybot.yellow_daily WHERE trip_date IN (DATE '2024-11-28', DATE '2024-11-07', DATE '2024-11-14', DATE '2024-11-21') LIMIT 500
